summary: The 'InternalComment' module handles the management of student enrollments, internal comments, and associated actions such as emailing, editing, and reactivating students.
purpose: To manage and display enrollment data, control access to student records, and facilitate updates to internal comments and associated enrollment actions.

fields.name: gridData
fields.description: GridView to display student enrollment data.

fields.name: ddAction
fields.description: Dropdown to select actions for student enrollments.

actors.name: User
actors.description: Person interacting with the enrollment data and executing actions.

actors.name: Student
actors.description: Subject of the enrollment management system.

workflows.name: Clear Internal Comments
steps: System clears internal comments for selected students.

validations: Ensure UserSession is active before database operations.
conditions: Screen is editable if not in ReadOnly mode and enrollment is not waived.
system_behavior: Displays StudentComments in the enrollment grid.
dependencies: DataLayer.Enrollment object provides core enrollment data.
Resources for various UI text and messages.
exceptions: Cancel database operations if UserSession is null.
